segments.sn4.3:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā nerañjarāya tīre ajapālanigrodhamūle paṭhamābhisambuddho.
segments.sn4.3:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ abbhokāse nisinno hoti, devo ca ekamekaṃ phusāyati.
segments.sn4.3:1.4: Atha kho māro pāpimā, bhagavato bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetukāmo, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato avidūre uccāvacā vaṇṇanibhā upadaṃseti, subhā ceva asubhā ca.
segments.sn4.3:1.5: Atha kho bhagavā “māro ayaṃ pāpimā” iti viditvā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn4.3:2.3: Alaṃ te tena pāpima, nihato tvamasi antaka.
segments.sn4.3:3.1: “Ye ca kāyena vācāya, manasā ca susaṃvutā;
segments.sn4.3:3.3: Na te māravasānugā, na te mārassa baddhagū”[baddhabhū (ka.), paccagū (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] ti.

lines: Na te māravasānugāti, māra, te tuyhaṃ vasānugā na honti.
Na te mārassa baddhagūti te tuyhaṃ mārassa baddhacarā sissā antevāsikā na honti.
